findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: format_citation, negotiate_bill_script, batch_scan_bills, lookup_cpt, get_appeal_deadline, get_venue · Private data: watch_appeal_outcome, estimate_appeal_success, dispute_case_builder, supporting_document_selector, get_venue · Public sink: submit_denial_letter, estimate_appeal_success, batch_scan_bills, inflation_adjusted_price_model, deductible_impact_calculator, coinsurance_simulator · Destructive: format_citation, format_medigami_citation, maximize_recovery, verify_dea_authorization, claim_consistency_checker, bundling_violation_detector, claim_duplicate_line_detector, payment_plan_optimizer.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: format_citation, negotiate_bill_script, batch_scan_bills, lookup_cpt, get_appeal_deadline, get_venue · Private data: watch_appeal_outcome, estimate_appeal_success, dispute_case_builder, supporting_document_selector, get_venue · Public sink: submit_denial_letter, estimate_appeal_success, batch_scan_bills, inflation_adjusted_price_model, deductible_impact_calculator, coinsurance_simulator · Destructive: format_citation, format_medigami_citation, maximize_recovery, verify_dea_authorization, claim_consistency_checker, bundling_violation_detector, claim_duplicate_line_detector, payment_plan_optimizer

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
